review_comments.body: **Fallback requests lose user settings.** The new branch clears fields on the caller's `chatReq`. With ordinary channel settings, the gateway reuses that same request across attempts. If `grok-4-fast-reasoning` fails and the gateway switches to a non-reasoning model, the fallback also loses the user's `stop` and penalty settings, even though it accepts them. Copy the request before clearing these fields so the change stays within the xAI attempt. **Knowledge Base Used:** [Provider protocol transformers](https://app.greptile.com/-/switch-tenant?tenant=looplj&next=%2Fcustom-context%2Fknowledge-base%2Flooplj%2Faxonhub%2F-%2Fdocs%2Fprovider-protocol-transformers.md)
